name: What mistakes or risks should I avoid when generating structured data?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes or risks should I avoid when generating structured data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common risks include invalid JSON-LD syntax, missing required properties, mismatched page content, and schema type errors that prevent rich result eligibility. Google requires schema to match supported types and required properties, plus your page must pass quality thresholds. Critical factors are using only valid Schema.org vocabulary, avoiding conflicting dates/authors, and keeping prices/availability fresh. Run automated unit tests that parse JSON-LD and check required properties on every code change. Validate in CI before deployment and monitor Search Console daily for errors after release.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid invalid syntax, missing required properties, content mismatches, and conflicting data; always validate with Rich Results Test and run CI checks.
